Q.name: Siphoning Strike
Q.title: Template:Data Nasus/Siphoning Strike
Q.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Siphoning Strike|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Nasus
|skill        = Q
|icon         = Siphoning Strike.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{cis|Nasus}} next basic attack within a period will gain {{sti|range|'''bonus''' range}} and deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} based on the amount of {{as|Siphoning Strike|buzzword}} stacks.
|blurb2      = If this attack kills the target, '''Nasus''' generates permanent stacks of {{as|Siphoning Strike|buzzword}}, increased against {{tip|champions}}, large {{tip|minions}}, and large {{tip|monsters}}.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nasus''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} within 10 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|range|50 '''bonus''' range}}, and deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}. ''Siphoning Strike's'' flat '''bonus''' damage is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
|leveling     = {{st|Bonus Physical Damage|{{ap|40 to 120}} {{as|(+ 100% of ''Siphoning Strike'' stacks)|buzzword}}}}
|description2 = If ''Siphoning Strike'' kills the target, '''Nasus''' permanently gains {{as|4 stacks|buzzword}}, increased to {{as|10|buzzword}} if the target is a {{tip|champion}}, large {{tip|minion}}, or large {{tip|monster}}.
|description3 = ''Siphoning Strike {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Nasus'''' basic attack timer.''
|cooldown     = {{ap|7.5 to 3.5}}
|cdstart      = post-effect
|cost         = 20
|costtype     = Mana
|cast time = none
|targeting    = Auto
|affects      = Self
|damagetype   = Physical
|spelleffects = special
|spellshield  = false
|parry        = true
|notes        = 
* Both ''Siphoning Strike's'' '''base''' damage and damage from stacks are treated as {{tip|basic damage}} but also trigger spell effects by also being tagged as {{tip|spell damage}}.
** The {{tip|basic attack}} is also considered a part of ''Siphoning Strike'' and treated as both {{tip|basic damage}} and {{tip|spell damage}}.
* '''Nasus''' can gain ''Siphoning Strike'' {{as|stacks|buzzword}} by killing any enemy unit, this includes {{tip|champions}}, {{tip|minions}}, {{tip|monsters}}, {{tip|wards}}, {{tip|turrets}}, and {{tip|pets}}. 
** [[Jungle plants]] and {{tip|structures}} that are not turrets (e.g. [[inhibitors]]) will not grant {{as|stacks|buzzword}}.
* ''Siphoning Strike'' will not generate {{as|stacks|buzzword}} from secondary units killed by other effects (e.g. {{ii|Tiamat}}).
* ''Siphoning Strike'' will trigger {{iis|Tear of the Goddess}} {{nie|Manaflow}}.
}}
